content.text: The council partnered with Cambridgeshire Police on the project, aiming to disrupt criminal organizations and ensure the safety of public areas.
In 2023, the Alliance project was established in the Millfield and Lincoln Road area of Peterborough as part of the Home Office's Clear, Hold and Build strategy.
The Local Democracy Reporting Service said cases included the seizure of 700,000 cigarettes with a value of £200,000, 20,000 vapes at a value of between £20,000 and £40,000 and £115,000 in cash.
